title: Configure project-specific landing worker, dev server and release cadence
description: During init/install detect and propose services the project needs: one serialized landing executor, local owner Console/dev server, daily local digest, and optional project release/live verification jobs. Do not assume Vercel, game builds, HTTPS/LAN exposure, 08:00/16:00 release or network credentials. Schedule selection, destinations, port/TLS and release budgets appear in the owner-reviewed setup plan; unsafe/missing integrations remain visibly unconfigured.
acceptanceCriteria: One landing worker per approved project cannot race main pushes and cannot bypass exact checks
Local-only dev Console can be configured without silently exposing LAN/public access
Release/deploy and notifications are disabled until destination-specific approval; retries/status/live version proof are preserved
System versus active-fleet job lifetimes are explicit and stop/reinstall do not orphan services
